text:
Amanda: Quick announcement: we're changing how runnable code snippets in our public docs are executed by CI. Please read — this will affect snippet PRs going forward.

Jon: TL;DR?

Amanda: TL;DR: the snippet execution timeout used by our docs CI will be lowered from 30s to 5s for inline snippets. This is to reduce CI flakiness and speed up reviews. Sample-app repos and hosted playground examples are unaffected.

Kai: So only "inline" snippets that the snippet-checker runs are affected, right? Not the full sample apps?

Amanda: Correct. Inline snippets embedded in markdown (docs/*) that are automatically executed by snippet-checker will have a 5s cap. Playgrounds and sample-apps keep their current longer timeouts. We'll add clear markers in docs so authors know which path applies.

docs-bot: Automation update: snippet-checker will run with flag --timeout=5s for paths matching docs/** starting next week. Failing snippets will cause docs CI to fail and an automated comment will be posted. See internal CI doc: https://go.redwood/ci-snippet-timeout :robot_face:

Lina: I'll prepare a short migration doc with patterns: (1) reduce real runtime by simplifying the example, (2) replace with mocked output, or (3) move the long-run demo into sample-apps and link to it. Will attach PR template updates.

Jon: I'll update CONTRIBUTING.md and the docs PR checklist to mention the 5s inline rule and add the suggested patterns.

Amanda: Example language we can add to the docs: 

```js
// JS inline docs: keep examples short or show mock output
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, timeout: 5000 }); // inline snippets: 5s
// For full examples, link to sample-apps with a longer timeout
```

```py
# Python inline docs: show async/short example and link to full-run in sample repo
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'), timeout=5)  # inline: small timeout
```

Kai: What about examples that demonstrate streaming or long generation sequences?

Amanda: For streaming demos, show the connection handshake and first chunk, then elide with "..." and point to the hosted example for the full transcript. We'll add a stream-template snippet for that.

docs-bot: Rollout plan: toggle enforcement in staging on Mon, 2026-04-06; enforce on main on Wed, 2026-04-08. Automated notices will be sent to authors of affected PRs.

Lina: Opening the migration guide PR now and will include three concrete refactor patterns + sample diffs.

Jon: I'll circulate a heads-up to active docs authors and add a note to the weekly docs digest.

Amanda: Thanks — please escalate any edge cases. We'll revisit after one week of enforcement to decide if tweaks are needed.

docs-bot: Reminder: authors of failing snippets will receive a bot comment with suggested fixes and links to the migration guide.

Amanda: If no objections I'll consider this final and proceed with the rollout schedule.
